archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted to Premium Purple SaaS as requested)
mood: Premium, calm, intelligent, modern, smooth, trustworthy, visually refined

typography.heading_strategy: Clean modern sans-serif with tight tracking for a premium enterprise feel. Outfit gives a sophisticated geometric tech vibe.
typography.body_strategy: Inter or Outfit with loose line-height for readability in dense ERP grids.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8). Generous padding to create 'breathing space' and uncluttered hierarchy.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento-style structured grids for dashboards. Dense but spacious.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inner widgets, rounded-lg for small inputs.
layout_and_spacing.cards: Polished, soft glow edges, subtle reflections. Use 1px inner borders `border border-white/40 shadow-sm`.
layout_and_spacing.glassmorphism: Used selectively on Top Navbar, Sidebar Panel, Key Dashboard Cards, Search Modal. `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70`.

components.buttons: Premium feel. Solid primary buttons have soft shadows (`shadow-md`). Hover states scale up slightly (`hover:-translate-y-[1px]`) and brighten. Use `data-testid` on all.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Custom rounded corners, soft focus rings (`focus:ring-indigo-500/30`), border-slate-200.
components.navigation: Top Navbar with Glassmorphism. Dynamic Left Sidebar with active state indicators (smooth sliding background pill).
components.cards: White or Glass background, `border border-slate-100`, subtle `shadow-sm` upgrading to `shadow-md` on hover. Use translucent layers.
components.charts: Recharts with soft curves (`type='monotone'`), gradient fills (using `<defs><linearGradient>`), matching the module's accent color.
components.data_tables: Clean, spacious rows. No vertical dividers. Subtle hover states on rows. Sticky headers with glass effect.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Smooth fade, elegant gradient shifts. `transition-all duration-300 ease-out`.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Cards respond to cursor proximity (magnetic/lift). Soft cursor reactive glow near buttons. `hover:-translate-y-1`.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and lists.
motion_and_interactions.microinteractions: Sidebar active item slides smoothly. Buttons click press states (`active:scale-95`).

icons.style: Clean, line-based, stroke-width 1.5 for a delicate premium feel.

logos.brand: TechnoBiz Smart ERP (Text Logo with a subtle purple icon)

background_texture.description: Abstract geometric shapes floating on a purple background - use sparingly as an ambient blur behind the dashboard

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a hybrid fullstack app featuring a layout with a Top Nav, Left Sidebar, and main content area.
Implement the Dashboard, Inventory, and Finance views.
Top Nav must include a global search command palette, notifications drawer, and user profile.
Dashboard should have 6 KPI cards with sparklines, an interactive chart for Cash Flow, and AI Smart Alert widgets.
Implement the dynamic module color system via contextual CSS variables or tailored Tailwind classes depending on the active module route.
Ensure glassmorphism is implemented cleanly using `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70` on the Top Nav and Sidebar.
Use Recharts for all data visualization needs. Apply soft glow effects (`drop-shadow`) to chart lines to meet the 'premium SaaS' requirement.
Apply Framer Motion or Tailwind transitions to make interactions fluid (250-450ms).
